source.name: SportsBusiness Journal – 'Orlando Health puts name on two more jerseys'
source.quote: Orlando Health was Orlando City’s first sponsor as an MLS expansion team this year and has been the club’s jersey sponsor since its USL debut in 2011.

note: Jersey partnership dating to the club's first 2011 season, renewed and expanded in December 2015 (through 2021 at the time), then renewed long-term in June 2021 (club announcement: 'Orlando Health will continue to serve as the presenting partner and jersey partner of Orlando City SC', orlandocitysc.com, June 14, 2021). The 2026 Sunken Treasure kit is presented by Orlando Health through the 2027-28 season. No club-specific value was disclosed: SBJ reported the club's VP declined financial details, noting only that MLS jersey sponsorships are typically valued between $2 million and $4 million a year league-wide, so value is left null.
